michelle: Quick sync — planning to kick off release train 3.2 today 2026-04-02 16:00 PT :rocket:
michelle: Staggered rollout plan: us-west -> us-east -> eu -> apac. 15m observation between waves.
michelle: Need owners for each service and smoke-check confirmations. Canary 5% for model-inference and 10% for api-gateway.
jordan: I'll take api-gateway, targeting the 16:00 us-west window. I'll run smoke checks and watch logs :eyes:
priya: I'll own model-inference canary. I'll do a dry-run on staging at 15:20 and post results here.
liam: I'll cover auth-service and be on-call for rollback. Can do 16:15 for the second wave.
ana: typo — meant to ping @ana for DB coordination.
ana: Please ignore this message.
ana: (sorry, false alarm)
ana: ---
ana: Actually rephrasing: ana: I'll coordinate database migrations if any and approve downtime windows.
ci-bot: CI pipeline passed for train/3.2 at 15:40 — all tests green :white_check_mark:
michelle: Smoke checklist (quick) — reply when done:
michelle: 1) health endpoints ok
michelle: 2) basic e2e flow (login->predict) < 1s
michelle: 3) error rate <0.5% prev window
michelle: 4) no schema drift in logs
priya: Staging dry-run done — model-inference latency looks good, no error spikes. Uploading logs: https://redwood.logs/s/abcd123
jordan: Gate passed for us-west. Starting canary deploy now :rocket:
deploy-bot: canary deploy started for api-gateway (5% traffic) — run id: dpl-20260402-01
liam: I'll be on call for rollback. Rollback command if needed:
liam: ```
redwoodctl deploy rollback --service api-gateway --release 3.1 --reason "canary-fail"
```
ana: DB migrations are zero-downtime; no locks expected.
michelle: Hold for 15m observation after us-west. If stable, we'll continue to us-east at 16:30.
priya: Canary stable at +10m — no regressions. :thumbsup:
michelle: Thanks — proceeding to us-east wave in 5m. @liam @ana @jordan please be ready for smoke checks.
jordan: Ready, tailing logs
liam: Ready
ana: Ready
michelle: If anyone needs to abort, call it out ASAP. Otherwise, post checks done and we'll close the train.
priya: All waves completed, final smoke checks fine. Marking train 3.2 green :tada:
ci-bot: Release train 3.2 marked SUCCESS by michelle
michelle: Great job team — I'll file a short release note and update the rollout board.
